description: This Java class manages resource files in an Android project, including scanning, updating, and tracking resource items and resource files within resource folders. It also listens to PSI tree changes to keep the resource repository up-to-date.

classes.name: ResourceFolderRepository
classes.description: Manages resource files and resource items within Android resource folders, including scanning, updating, and listening to PSI tree changes to keep resources synchronized.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ResourceFolderRepository for a given AndroidFacet and resource directory.

methods.name: getFacet
methods.description: Returns the AndroidFacet associated with this resource repository.

methods.name: getResourceDir
methods.description: Returns the VirtualFile representing the resource directory.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Initiates scanning of the resource folder to populate resource items.

methods.name: ensureValid
methods.description: Ensures the given PsiFile is valid and re-fetches it if necessary.

methods.name: scanResFolder
methods.description: Recursively scans subdirectories of the resource folder to identify resource files.

methods.name: getQualifiers
methods.description: Extracts qualifiers from a resource directory name.

methods.name: scanFileResourceFolder
methods.description: Scans a specific resource folder for resource files and populates resource items.

methods.name: scanFileResourceFile
methods.description: Processes individual resource files (XML or images) to create resource items.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the map of resource items categorized by resource type.

methods.name: getMap(ResourceType, boolean)
methods.description: Returns or creates the resource items map for a specific resource type.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all resource items and resource files from the repository.

methods.name: addIds
methods.description: Adds ID resource items found within a PsiFile or PsiElement to the resource collection.

methods.name: addId
methods.description: Adds a single ID resource item from an XmlTag.

methods.name: scanValueResFolder
methods.description: Scans a 'values' resource folder for resource definitions.

methods.name: scanValueFile
methods.description: Processes a 'values' XML resource file to extract resource items.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the ResourceType of an XmlTag based on its name and attributes.

methods.name: isResourceFolder
methods.description: Checks if a PsiElement represents a resource folder.

methods.name: isResourceFile
methods.description: Checks if a PsiFile is a resource file within a resource folder.

methods.name: isScanPending
methods.description: Checks if a PsiFile is pending a rescan.

methods.name: rescan
methods.description: Schedules a rescan of a PsiFile for resource updates.

methods.name: rescanImmediately
methods.description: Performs an immediate rescan of a resource file, updating resource items.

methods.name: removeItems
methods.description: Removes resource items of a specific type and name from the repository.

methods.name: bitmapUpdated
methods.description: Handles updates when a bitmap resource has changed or been deleted.

methods.name: getPsiListener
methods.description: Returns the PsiTreeChangeListener that keeps the resource repository synchronized with PSI changes.

methods.name: findResourceFile
methods.description: Finds a resource file by directory name and filename.

methods.name: removeItemsFromFile
methods.description: Removes all resource items associated with a given resource file.

methods.name: isItemElement
methods.description: Checks if an XmlTag is a resource item element.

methods.name: findValueResourceItem
methods.description: Finds a resource item within a resource file based on an XmlTag.

methods.name: findResourceItem
methods.description: Locates a resource item by type, file, name, and tag.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ResourceFolderRepository instance.
